sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx, 400x300, 17 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD <=35 mK; optical: 1/1.8in 4MP CMOS
features: anti-corrosion bi-spectrum thermal + 4MP visible hybrid bullet
anti-corrosion coating for marine / corrosive environments
white-light illuminator, illumination distance up to 80 m; smart linkage of white light and audio

release_notes: Anti-corrosion variant of the fixed thermal + 4MP visible hybrid bullet, coated for corrosive sites with a white-light illuminator (80 m) and smart light/audio linkage.

frigate.notes: Dahua RTSP convention; channel 1 = visible/fusion, channel 2 = thermal. Not verified against a live unit.

home_assistant.notes: Dahua ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal and visible exposed as separate channels (visible = channel 1, thermal = channel 2).
